description.value:
Shii-Cho looks chaotic on purpose: wild, seemingly random cuts meant to unbalance and disarm an opponent before they ever find a rhythm to fight back. Beneath the apparent disorder lies real intent — every stroke is chosen to leave the enemy scrambling for footing.

Guardians who train in Shii-Cho thrive on that confusion, herding foes into vulnerable positions with unpredictable footwork and using the resulting openings to press an advantage that a more disciplined opponent never sees coming.
